a: Enforce max body size at proxy and app layers.
Verify file signatures, not only client-provided Content-Type.
Store objects under random keys; never trust user filenames as paths.
Serve untrusted files as attachments when possible.
Re-encode images to strip active content.
Serve user content from a different domain/origin.
Client uploads directly to object storage with short-lived credentials.
SVG can contain scripts; sanitize or block.
